create_video_classification_dataset: create a VideoClassificationDataset instance from a dataset directory with task config and preprocessor
get_class_info: get class IDs and names from directory structure or labels text file
load_video_frames: load uniformly sampled frames from a video file using decord with cv2 fallback
getitem_sample: retrieve a preprocessed list of video frames and their class ID by index
clean_label: clean a class label by removing parentheses and stripping underscores
